Independent tests check minimal stage indices from the closed formulas rather than from production outputs.
layers.remaining_boundary: Actual Section 7/8 corrections, C_{j,m}, P_{j,m}, theorem-derived K_m, the flat E_{j,m} remainder, locally finite Eq. (9.21) sums, convergence of the correction sequence, and Proposition 9.9 residual flatness remain unproved. K_m remains an explicit supplied theorem datum, never a fitted sample quantity.
